meta.name: Generate Image (MiniMax H3 Image)
meta.licenseNote: MiniMax H3 Community License (MiniMax, 2026): the grant excludes the EU, the UK, South Korea and the USA; over USD 1M yearly revenue or a hosted service needs MiniMax's OK; show "Powered by MiniMax H3"; outputs may not train other models. Bring your own files. The app ships no weights.
meta.notes: Runs natively (genai-native gn-diffusion minimax-h3-image/image, qwen-image-rs h3): MiniMax-H3-Image (the 33B H3 DiT with one image latent, no audio, and six stacked output heads), the raw prompt through the first 50 layers of Qwen3-VL-32B (NVFP4, its layers on the card one at a time beside the DiT), Euler on the six sigmas the heads were distilled for, no shift, no CFG, the tiled ViT VAE decode. Sides multiples of 32; tuned for 4 MP, made for 16 MP.
meta.creator: MiniMax
meta.description: The largest open picture model: up to 16 MP in six steps (5090 class)
